health.data_class: synthetic only — no PHI, by design and by review
health.gate: the escalation decision is deterministic Python reading Prediction.crosses_boundary; no language model chooses whether to escalate

offer.question: This patient's predicted trough interval reaches a boundary of their care plan, and the current estimate cannot be independently checked. Take extra samples?

burden.note: Draws beyond the trough already scheduled. This is what the patient actually experiences as extra.

secondary_parameter_precision.note: Parameter precision, NOT accuracy. It scores a trough-only fit higher than a curve fit because the trough-only fit assumes absorption away. Do not lead a clinician-facing card with these.

evidence.claim: Population pharmacokinetic parameters, between-patient variability and residual error are taken unchanged from the published model: Fernandez-Alarcon B, et al. Guiding the starting dose of the once-daily formulation of tacrolimus in de novo adult renal transplant patients: a population approach. Front Pharmacol 2024;15:1456565. doi:10.3389/fphar.2024.1456565
evidence.population_limit: Derived in 138 DE NOVO adult renal transplant recipients on extended-release tacrolimus, sampled on days 5 to 15 after transplantation. A maintenance patient months post-transplant is an extrapolation.

evidence.claim: Therapeutic range 5-10 ng/mL, as written in this patient's own care plan: Fernandez-Alarcon B, et al. Front Pharmacol 2024;15:1456565 — the SAME study this project's population prior is taken from: 'a predefined therapeutic target of 5-10 ng/mL' in de novo adult renal transplant recipients on ADVAGRAF (Astellas), the once-daily prolonged-release formulation.
evidence.population_limit: The range is the clinician's, not the software's. It is applied as written and is never adjusted, widened or inferred.

evidence.claim: Absorption was held at the population value, not estimated: this fit has no post-dose samples able to identify it.
evidence.population_limit: Three of the model's six parameters are individualised at most. Absorption is not one of them here.

prediction.interval_note: A PREDICTION interval for a future measured trough — what the laboratory will report — not a credible interval on the typical value. It is the wider of the two, and it is the one a therapeutic range is written against.

clinician_view.calibration_note: This profile rests on 4 measured concentrations. The 24-hour exposure interval is 37% wide relative to its own median. Nothing can currently check this estimate but itself: the published limited-sampling equation needs post-dose samples this patient has not given, so a four-point occasion timed from the next dose would make it runnable.
